quotations.old_english: Hiera ryht fæderencyn [fædrencynn, Th. 87, 14, col. 1] gǽþ to Cerdice
quotations.english: their direct paternal kin goes to Cerdic

quotations.old_english: We areccan ne mágon ðæt fædrencynn
quotations.english: we cannot tell the paternal kin

source_text: fæderen-cyn, fædren-cyn, -cynn, es ; n. [cyn a race, kin] A paternal kin or race; p&a-short;ternum g&e-short;nus :-- Hiera ryht fæderencyn [fædrencynn, Th. 87, 14, col. 1] gǽþ to Cerdice their direct paternal kin goes to Cerdic, Chr. 755 Th. 86, 14, col. 1. We areccan ne mágon ðæt fædrencynn we cannot tell the paternal kin, Exon. 11 b ; Th. 16, 4 ; Cri. 248.
